title: Figure 8: Oscillatory voltage from precessional motion of free magnet in a nanopillar
description: Green time-series plot labeled 'C', showing Voltage (microvolts, about -100 to 100) oscillating rapidly over Time (ns, 0-10). Captioned 'Figure 8. Oscillatory Voltage Generated by Precessional Motion of the Free Magnet in IrMn8nm/NiFe4nm/Cu8nm/NiFe4nm Nanopillar, in Response to a 335-mV dc Voltage Step Applied to the Device at B = 630 Oersteds (Reference 51)'.
